name: Winton Woods Campground
evidence: OSIP leaf-off + booking-map pins: full-hookup site 14 is ~19 m from Winton Lake through a continuous ~12 m brush band; other west-row pads ~45 m through woods. Point sites 41-49 etc. ~18-28 m behind the same fringe, sold as 30-amp tent sites, RV fit unconfirmed; site photos 404. Screen, so a filtered view; kayak launch at 86 does not count.

name: Sandy Springs Campground
evidence: OSIP leaf-off + Esri leaf-on at 38.6044,-83.2820: east pads behind continuous riparian trees; south pads ~40 m across open grass to the Ohio River and boat ramp, but DEM drops ~10 m (158 m to 148 m, pool) at the bank, so climb-down, not walk-across; river visible. 'Riverside' sites unmapped (operator site walled); reviews of site 6 are leads only.
